subject: Partner launch ops & co-sell pricing cadence — BridgeWorks bundle
messages:
From: Naomi Feldman <naomi@redwood.com>
To: Rohit Shah <rohit@bridgeworks.ai>, Clara Li <clara@cloudarch.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>, Olga Petrov <olga@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 29 Jul 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Partner launch ops & co-sell pricing cadence — BridgeWorks bundle

Thanks Rohit + Clara — great conversation earlier this week. Per our sync, I pulled together an initial ops checklist and timeline for the bundled listing + co-sell motion. Attached is a simple timeline (launch_timeline_v1.xlsx) with the key milestones we discussed: catalog metadata submission, SKU mapping, metering integration, co-sell certification, and marketing comms.

Two asks to keep this moving:
- Can you confirm the SKU list and preferred pricing tiers for the bundle by EOD next Tue (Aug 3)? We need that to generate the catalog entry and price commitment.
- Can your engineering team share the expected metering event format (or a sample payload) so Olga can validate integration scope and estimate ETA?

Tentative internal owners: Ben will own co-sell commercial (discounts / MOU), Olga will own technical integration, and Karthik will coordinate marketplace certification. Ill own the launch plan and partner communications.

If helpful, we can do a 30-min ops walk-through next week. Availability: Tue 8/3 10–11 PT or Wed 8/4 1–3 PT.

Thanks — Naomi
Naomi Feldman
Director, Partnerships | Redwood Inference
naomi@redwood.com

Attachment: launch_timeline_v1.xlsx (spreadsheet, 120KB)

From: Rohit Shah <rohit@bridgeworks.ai>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi@redwood.com>
Cc: Partnership Ops <partnerships@bridgeworks.ai>, Clara Li <clara@cloudarch.com>
Date: Fri, 30 Jul 2027 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Partner launch ops & co-sell pricing cadence — BridgeWorks bundle

Thanks Naomi — appreciate the clear checklist. Attaching our current SKU map (bridgeworks_sku_map.xlsx) with the three bundle SKUs wed like listed:
- BW-Core + Redwood Hosted Inference (monthly)
- BW-Enterprise + Redwood Dedicated (annual commit)
- BW-Analytics add-on (consumption)

Pricing tiers and suggested MSRPs are in tab "PricingProposal". For the co-sell pricing were proposing a 15% referral credit on revenue recognized through the cloud marketplace for the first 12 months; Ben, happy to work with you on the commercial terms.

On metering: we currently emit usage as protobuf events to an internal ingestion pipeline; I can export a sample JSON schema this week. Sandbox credentials for a staging metering endpoint are available — Ill copy Partnership Ops who can provision access.

Were available for the ops walk-through Tue 8/3 10–11 PT.

— Rohit
Rohit Shah
Head of Partnerships | BridgeWorks AI
rohit@bridgeworks.ai

Attachment: bridgeworks_sku_map.xlsx (spreadsheet, 85KB)

From: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>
To: Rohit Shah <rohit@bridgeworks.ai>, Naomi Feldman <naomi@redwood.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>, Partnership Ops <partnerships@bridgeworks.ai>
Date: Mon, 2 Aug 2027 08:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Partner launch ops & co-sell pricing cadence — BridgeWorks bundle

Rohit — thanks for the SKU map and the pricing proposal. A few commercial notes:
- The 15% referral credit is reasonable as a starting point; legal will need to run standard language but I dont expect major blockers.
- Well propose a 9-month ramp-and-review clause rather than fixed 12 months to align incentives.

Ive attached a draft MOU we often use for co-sell pilots. Can you review co-sell_mou_draft.docx and flag any redlines by Fri 8/6 so we can get DocuSign out? Also tagging Karthik for certification timing — Karthik, can you confirm required artifacts for GCP/Azure listings?

Thanks,
Ben Carter
Head of Alliances | Redwood Inference
ben@redwood.com

Attachment: co-sell_mou_draft.docx (docx, 45KB)

From: Olga Petrov <olga@redwood.com>
To: Rohit Shah <rohit@bridgeworks.ai>, Naomi Feldman <naomi@redwood.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 4 Aug 2027 14:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Partner launch ops & co-sell pricing cadence — BridgeWorks bundle

Rohit / Naomi — digging into metering details. Quick technical summary / asks:
- Our preferred ingestion is an HTTPS POST with a JSON envelope (schema attached: redwood_metering_spec.pdf). If you can provide a sample payload (or a one-off export from your protobuf pipeline), that will let me confirm mapping of BW usage -> Redwood consumption metric.
- For consumption SKUs (BW-Analytics add-on), we need a per-token and per-request mapping to preserve accurate billing attribution.
- Sandbox endpoints + an API key scoped to the "metering:ingest:staging" role will be enough for initial validation.

I can run a short POC once we have a sample payload — estimate 3 business days to validate fields and return a mapping doc.

Olga Petrov
Senior Integration Engineer | Redwood Inference
olga@redwood.com

Attachment: redwood_metering_spec.pdf (pdf, 160KB)

From: Rohit Shah <rohit@bridgeworks.ai>
To: Olga Petrov <olga@redwood.com>, Naomi Feldman <naomi@redwood.com>
Cc: Partnership Ops <partnerships@bridgeworks.ai>, Clara Li <clara@cloudarch.com>
Date: Thu, 5 Aug 2027 09:48:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Partner launch ops & co-sell pricing cadence — BridgeWorks bundle

Thanks Olga — Ive exported a sample JSON payload and uploaded it to our staging bucket. Partnership Ops will share a temporary signed URL and create a sandbox API key by EOD. A couple of operational Qs:
- Do you have recommended rate limits for ingestion? Were trying to size the proxy layer.
- For marketplace listings that require an "annual commit" SKU (BW-Enterprise), what evidence does certification require for reserved capacity? Karthik, can you advise?

Were aligned to review the MOU and will aim to return redlines by Fri 8/6.

— Rohit

Attachment: none (staging link to sample payload to be shared)

From: Naomi Feldman <naomi@redwood.com>
To: Rohit Shah <rohit@bridgeworks.ai>, Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>, Olga Petrov <olga@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 9 Aug 2027 16:38:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Partner launch ops & co-sell pricing cadence — BridgeWorks bundle

Great progress team — quick summary and confirmed next steps:
1) Commercial: Ben / Rohit to exchange redlines on the MOU by Fri 8/6 (Ben, please confirm when legal has a review slot). DocuSign link will be used for signature once terms are agreed.
2) Technical: Rohit / Partnership Ops to share signed URL + sandbox API key (Rohit said EOD 8/5). Olga will run POC (3 business days) and deliver a mapping doc.
3) Certification: Karthik to list required artifacts for annual-commit SKUs (expected: SLA doc, telemetry sample, security questionnaire). Karthik — can you publish the artifact checklist to the Drive folder by Thu 8/12?
4) Ops sync: Confirmed 30-min ops walkthrough Tue 8/3 10–11 PT (recording will be saved to the Drive folder).

Ownership: Ben (commercial), Olga (integration), Karthik (certification), Naomi (launch comms).

If there are any blockers, flag to me and Ill escalate. Thanks all — excited to get this bundle live.

Best,
Naomi Feldman
Director, Partnerships | Redwood Inference
naomi@redwood.com

Related links: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1aB-gh-Partner-LAUNCH
Attachments referenced: launch_timeline_v1.xlsx, bridgeworks_sku_map.xlsx, co-sell_mou_draft.docx, redwood_metering_spec.pdf
